mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_budget_reservation (request_id, budget_type, target_id, user_id, reserved_amount, settled_amount, status, expire_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{budgetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{reservedAmount}, #{settledAmount}, #{status}, #{expireAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_budget_reservation SET status = #{status}, settled_amount = #{settledAmount}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, budget_type, target_id, user_id, reserved_amount, settled_amount, status, expire_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_budget_reservation WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT id, request_id, budget_type, target_id, user_id, reserved_amount, settled_amount, status, expire_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_budget_reservation WHERE status = 'RESERVED' AND expire_at < #{now} ORDER BY expire_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
